h1.cap: Myth... a great idea sells itself.

n2.cap: Fact... a great idea makes enemies. Machiavelli knew it in 1513.

n3.cap: Maya, new on her team, finds a way to do the weekly report in half the time.

n4.cap: The people who built the old way push back. The people it helps... just shrug.

q1.cap: He wrote... "the innovator has for enemies all those who have done well under the old conditions, and lukewarm defenders in those who may do well under the new."

n5.cap: Two groups. One has something to lose. The other... doesn't believe it yet.

n6.cap: In essence... people don't trust new things until they've lived with them a long time.

n7.cap: My take? Stop pouring your energy into the critics. Win the shruggers... with proof, not speeches.

n8.cap: Maya quietly runs her method for one week... then shows the hours saved. Now the shruggers defend it.

n9.cap: Today, build the smallest version of your idea that works... and show one person it helps.

n10.cap: What change did people fight you on? Tell me below.
